name: fileview_browser_example
description: Example file browser — one pict-section-fileview instance driven by a clickable file list (live type dispatch, same-kind reuse, type-switch teardown)

scripts.build: npx quack build && npx quack copy

author: steven

ExampleApplication.Title: Fileview Browser
ExampleApplication.Summary: A single pict-section-fileview embedded in an app shell and driven by a file list — clicking a file re-points the viewer, which dispatches to the right lens, reuses the live child on a same-kind re-point, and tears it down on a type switch.
